name: Azure Databricks
short_description: A first-party managed Apache Spark analytics service on Azure, built by Microsoft and Databricks, for data engineering, analytics and machine learning on data kept in your own storage.

evidence.quote: Azure Databricks is a managed service inside Azure, where you point code at your data and get answers
So as we see the genie in the data bricks
And if you're using Azure Databricks, the same Python SDK works in Databricks notebooks
